pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Main Line, 10.e5: 12.Bg5 Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 1 relied on Nd2 and g2-g4 with no clear purpose; plan 2 pushed ...a6/...b5 and ignored ...Nxe5 and the b2-pawn. Rewrote both plans; first rewrite of plan 2 said "win back material" (material is level; reviewer catch).

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Main Line, 10.e5: 12.Bg5 Qb6 13.O-O Nxe5 14.d6
pages.notes: Overview called 14.d6 a d-pawn sacrifice (the e-pawn was given up); plan 1 played Rf3-g3 with the rook on f1. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Main Line, 10.e5: 12.Bg5 Qb6 13.O-O Nxe5 14.Nxe5
pages.notes: Plan 3 targeted a d6-pawn and plan 4 an e5-pawn, neither on the board; plan 1 was generic. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Main Line, 10.e5: 12.e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Qh5 through the e2-bishop; plan 2 targeted an e5-pawn that is not there. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Main Line, 10.Nd2 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nd2-f1-g3 with a rook on f1 after castling; plan 3 had the g7-bishop hitting e4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Classical Variation, Traditional Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a3 to stop ...b5; plan 2 played ...Na6-c7 after ...a6; plan 3 rerouted Nf3-e1 with the king on e1. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 7...a6 8.a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 controlled b4 with Bg5; plan 4 played ...Na6-c7 with a pawn on a6. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 7...a6 8.a4 Bg4
pages.notes: Overview had ...Bxf3 shattering White's pawns (the queen recaptures); plan 2 relied on gxf3 and an open g-file. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Ne8-d7 with the king on e8; plan 3 rerouted Nd2-f1 with no knight on d2; plan 4 spoke of exchanging a "bad" d6-pawn. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 8.Bd3 O-O 9.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 3 read c4 as a move; rewritten and accepted. Plan 4 says the g7-bishop targets e4 and the kingside, which is wrong (its diagonal runs to c3 and b2 and is blocked by the f6-knight); two rewrites were rejected by the reviewer (second: the f6-knight blocks the bishop while it hits e4), so plan 4 is left as it was. Suggested direction: f6-knight and ...Re8 against e4; once the knight moves, the g7-bishop bears on c3 and b2.
